save_model: save a PyTorch model to a file using torch.save for later loading
load_model: load a serialized PyTorch model from a file using torch.load
set_seed: set a random seed across PyTorch, CUDA, Python random, and NumPy
use_cuda: enable CUDA and set the default tensor device by device ID
ContextGenerator: create a ContextGenerator from a file and sample or iterate over dialogue context pairs
